bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to education finance; authorizing a PSEO adjustment for Independent School District No. 186, Pequot Lakes; appropriating money.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; PSEO ADJUSTMENT; PEQUOT LAKES.

Subdivision 1.

Department of Education.

The sum indicated in this section is appropriated from the general fund to the Department of Education in the fiscal year designated.

Subd. 2.

PSEO adjustment.

(a) For a general education aid adjustment for Independent School District No. 186, Pequot Lakes, attributable to conflicting PSEO information provided to the school district:

$

.......

.....

2026

(b) The Department of Education must calculate the reduction in aid in fiscal years 2024 and 2025 to Independent School District No. 186, Pequot Lakes, attributable to PSEO students enrolled in the school district taking a combined course load at both the postsecondary institution and high school in excess of 1.0 pupils in average daily membership.

(c) 100 percent of the amount calculated in paragraph (b) must be paid to the school district in fiscal year 2026.
additions: The sum indicated in this section is appropriated from the general fund to the Department of Education in the fiscal year designated.
(a) For a general education aid adjustment for Independent School District No. 186, Pequot Lakes, attributable to conflicting PSEO information provided to the school district:

(b) The Department of Education must calculate the reduction in aid in fiscal years 2024 and 2025 to Independent School District No. 186, Pequot Lakes, attributable to PSEO students enrolled in the school district taking a combined course load at both the postsecondary institution and high school in excess of 1.0 pupils in average daily membership.
(c) 100 percent of the amount calculated in paragraph (b) must be paid to the school district in fiscal year 2026.
